name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio: Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, trading a career in accounting for a passion ignited during a visit to Spa-Francorchamps. He started as a volunteer mechanic for a local racing team, rapidly absorbing technical skills and demonstrating a knack for organization. Though relatively new to a leadership role, Jean-Pierre compensates with an infectious enthusiasm and a willingness to learn from every challenge. His approach is collaborative and pragmatic, always seeking the most efficient path to achieving team goals. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a stocky build and a perpetually cheerful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with engineering diagrams.
Has a habit of humming classic F1 theme songs while working.
Insists on a weekly team breakfast featuring Belgian waffles.
